capabilities: Select scattered or contiguous rows across Bases pages
Set, append, remove or clear property values and tags in bulk
Preview changes and undo batches from history
Restore deleted notes while their backup remains
Export selected rows to CSV or Markdown
disambiguation: Not a row-merging or table-joining tool; it bulk-edits properties and tags of notes selected in a Bases table.
extras: All features are free with no account, activation or background network requests; source is maintained privately and releases ship readable JavaScript. Installation is manual until the community directory listing is approved.
problem: Changing a property or tag across many notes in a Bases table means editing each note one at a time.
summary: Bulk editor for Obsidian Bases that applies property and tag rules to selected notes, with preview, undo and CSV or Markdown export.
